cohort: A total of 419 pregnant patients with known unruptured intracranial aneurysms (UIAs) presenting for elective delivery were included in the final analysis, drawn from 6,624,556 obstetrical patients in the Nationwide Inpatient Sample.
finding: There was a significant trend over the 2010s toward permitting more spontaneous vaginal deliveries for obstetrical patients with known UIAs.
mod_finding: Patients in later years (2012-2020) were over twice as likely to have been given a trial of vaginal delivery (odds ratio: 2.01, 95% confidence interval: 1.29 to 3.14, P = 0.002).
